newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Singapore PM Goh to visit Cambodia Nov 4-5.
newsitem.headline: Singapore PM Goh to visit Cambodia Nov 4-5.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong will visit Cambodia with a large business delegation next week, Foreign Ministry officials said on Tuesday.

The Singaporean leader will arrive on November 4 for an overnight visit. He is expected to hold bilateral talks with co-premiers Prince Norodom Ranariddh and Hun Sen, and to meet King Norodom Sihanouk, Foreign Minister Ung Huot told Reuters.
Goh's agenda had yet to be finalised, but the spokesman said the two sides were expected to sign agreements on investment protection and promotion and on air services.
The Singapore premier, making his first visit to this country, is also set to open a brewery built by Singapore-based Asia Pacific Breweries.
A business delegation of about 50 people will remain in Cambodia after Goh returns home on November 5. Singapore is one of Cambodia's leading trade partners.
Ung Huot said Cambodia would also host a state visit by Malaysia's King Jaafar from December 2-5, although the schedule was still in the planning stage.

A Malaysian diplomat said the king was expected to hold talks with Sihanouk and the two premiers. He would also visit the ancient Angkor temples in northwest Cambodia and was to play golf on a course outside Phnom Penh.
The envoy said the visit, returning one by Sihanouk to Malaysia in 1994, was aimed at further strengthening bilateral relations.
